builds.description: Controlled reactivity-source audit. Every effective esbuild input is identical except libs/reactivity/index.ts. Both lanes use the same current server, Node writer, fixture, and one compiler emission. This contrasts the pre-private-binding snapshot with current owner-observation code; it does not isolate only one changed function.

validation.methodology: Fresh process per lane/size/repeat; rotated order for six repeats; accepting synchronous sink; source page DTO reused but eager JSX/tape formation and complete rendering remain timed; full body/row/field validation outside timing; host CPU and wall diagnostic, no HTTP/gRPC/backpressure claim. Validation mode renders exactly one page per lane/size and records no timings.
